vb_textbox.text: When you first play this game, click on the different gnomes to learn which options will give you the most options. Once you learn which option gives you the most, stick to that side. You will find that sticking to a side will help rather than the colour of the gnomes. Occasionally, check the other side to see how many mushrooms there are and switch if it is higher. You can switch, once your side has a low number twice in a row. Keep repeating these steps to ensure you receive a high score.
